items.title: Zealand Pharma pens $1.2bn AI obesity drug discovery pact with Generate
items.summary: The tie-up makes Zealand the latest pharma company to enlist Generate's AI-powered drug discovery services.

items.title: MHRA homes in on personalised healthcare and tech in new 2030 strategy
items.summary: The MHRA’s new 2030 strategy plans to make drug and device regulation more efficient and patient centric by using technologies like AI.

items.title: Soufflé Therapeutics snags $135m to bring trio of drugs to the clinic
items.summary: Pharma-backed Soufflé will now progress three drugs for FSHD, heart failure and muscle & metabolic disorders to the clinic.

items.title: Charles River partners with Magellan Stem Cells on cell therapy
items.summary: CRL has collaborated with Australian biotechnology firm Magellan Stem Cells to advance the development and clinical progress of Magellan's regenerative medicine candidate, Zelestrocel.

items.title: Pfizer partners with Enodia Therapeutics in $500m drug deal
items.summary: Pfizer and Enodia Therapeutics have announced a research collaboration and licensing deal potentially worth over $500m to discover and develop Sec61 inhibitors.
